title: AudioLDM: Text-to-Audio Generation with Latent Diffusion Models
layout_note: Panel (a) fills the left half at full height. Its path runs clockwise and opens to the left: audio waveform at top-left goes right through Audio Encoder, a white 'STFT+MelFB' bar crosses the top to VAE Encoder in the right column, the latent z0 sits beside Latent Diffusion in the centre, the right column drops through VAE Decoder to a spectrogram, and the bottom row runs back left through Vocoder to the generated waveform under the input. Text prompt and Text Encoder sit at mid-left feeding the centre. Panels (b) inpainting and (c) style transfer are stacked in the right half as short left-to-right rows (spectrogram, VAE Encoder, Latent Diffusion, VAE Decoder, spectrogram), with Text Encoder raised above the centre box; (c) adds a Forward Diffusion box below the encoder.
grouping: No background panels, frames or containers; the three panels are separated by whitespace alone and each carries an '(a)/(b)/(c) ... with AudioLDM' sub-caption beneath it. Grouping is by fill colour family, kept identical across all three panels: pale blue for Audio Encoder and Text Encoder, yellow/amber for VAE Encoder, VAE Decoder and (paler) Vocoder, green for Latent Diffusion, grey for Forward Diffusion. Arrow style groups paths: in (a) solid = training, dashed = sampling (legend under the panel), and a light-grey dash-dot pair of arrows ties the two encoders to a 'Contrastive objective' label; (b) and (c) use dotted arrows throughout.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles (moderate corner radius) with thin black outlines, pastel fills, no shadows; labels in bold serif, two lines inside each box. 'STFT+MelFB' is a long white rounded bar. Latents are drawn as small 3-D cuboids in pale yellow (z0, z-hat, z^ob; z^ob is two cuboids side by side), with the noised latent in (c) as a darker gold cuboid. Embeddings E^x and E^y are strips of square cells in blue shades with one or two dark cells, vertical in (a) and horizontal in (b)/(c). The VAE boxes carry a small yellow line-stack glyph in the top-right corner, narrowing downward on the encoder and widening on the decoder. The Forward Diffusion box has a grey speckled noise-texture fill. Audio appears as blue waveform rasters and mel spectrograms as purple-orange colormap rasters; the masked input in (b) has a black right half.
proposed_highlight: Nothing is boxed as 'the proposed system'; instead Latent Diffusion is the only green block and sits at the centre of every panel, where all conditions, noise z_N ~ N(0, I) and latents converge. The model's name appears only in the three panel sub-captions. Panels (b) and (c) reuse the exact block shapes and colours of (a), so the zero-shot uses read as rewirings of the same parts, with the one new block (Forward Diffusion) set apart by its grey noise texture.
lesson: Training and sampling share one drawing: the same blocks are wired once, with solid arrows for the training path and dashed arrows for the sampling path, and a two-entry line-style legend under the panel explains the difference.
notes: Venue and year printed on the paper PDF. Variables and tensor sizes are set as math beside the shapes (E^x in R^L, z0 in R^{C x T/r x F/r}, X-hat in R^{T x F}); the quoted text prompts are bold serif text set directly on the canvas, without a box. The dotted arrow style used in (b) and (c) is not in the legend. The recorded embedded images (waveforms and spectrograms) are left out of the measured palette.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
